principle: Execution, outcome, and attribution are three separate facts. A fix may be called effective ONLY with proven execution (task COMPLETED with evidence) AND a post-execution improvement. No metric/percentage is fabricated.

scenarios.scenario: Correction proposed, never executed; outcome improved
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: The issue improved, but OpsIQ cannot attribute the improvement to this correction because execution evidence is missing.

scenarios.scenario: Correction executed with evidence; no post-execution measurement
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: Correction executed with evidence, but the outcome has not been reassessed yet — effectiveness is not proven.

scenarios.scenario: Correction executed with evidence; outcome improved after execution
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: Correction executed with evidence; reassessment shows improvement after execution. Verified — no further action required unless the issue repeats.
scenarios.dbSimEvidence: db #3,#6 (persisted MONITOR_ONLY route is NOT completable — code NEVER_AUTO)

scenarios.scenario: Correction executed with evidence; outcome unchanged
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: Correction executed with evidence, but the outcome is unchanged — a follow-up review is required.

scenarios.scenario: Correction executed with evidence; outcome worsened after execution
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: Outcome worsened after execution — the correction did not work; a follow-up correction is required.

scenarios.scenario: Correction completion evidence weak; outcome changed
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: The outcome changed, but the execution evidence is too weak to attribute the change to this correction — firmer completion proof is needed.
SOP change drafted; adoption and adherence not yet verified.

scenarios.scenario: SOP adopted with evidence but no adherence re-check
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: SOP was adopted with evidence, but adherence has not been re-checked — it is not yet verified as followed.

scenarios.scenario: SOP adopted with evidence + re-check confirms it is followed
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: SOP adopted with evidence and a re-check confirms it is being followed.
Training assigned; completion evidence not yet submitted.

scenarios.scenario: Training completed with evidence but no reassessment
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: Training was completed with evidence, but post-training performance has not been reassessed.

scenarios.scenario: Training completed with evidence + worsened post-training outcome
scenarios.ownerVisibleWording: Training completed, but performance worsened afterwards — a follow-up review is required.
No execution evidence yet / not enough data — never a favourable guess.

usedIn.logic: classifyEffectivenessAttribution / classifySopAdherence / classifyTrainingEffectiveness; sop-training-effectiveness-loop sets attributionState and honest wording; process-execution-bridge-expansion routes by ROUTE_FOR_ATTRIBUTION; owner-now-view derives CorrectionExecutionState from the persisted pc:<id> task.
usedIn.ui: EffectivenessPanel renders an eff-item-attribution badge with the honest verdict.

falseAttributionEliminated: The engine no longer emits 'it appears to be working'; a measured improvement is only called verified with a persisted COMPLETED-with-evidence correction.
